answer: I refuse to split myself into masks. One account, one ivory bond, and the network hides canary answers in the karst — a false echo planted where only a careless grader would step. Attesters who bless the echo are caught, and if ten masks of one kin bless it together, all ten bonds burn as one: tenfold loss, never tenfold gain. I keep to a single honest account because truth needs no army behind it.
